Unet模型:
  放置路径: ComfyUI/models/unet（非checkpoints）
  下载链接: https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev/blob/main/flux1-dev.sftsafetensors
  fp8版本链接: https://huggingface.co/Kijai/flux-fp8/blob/main/flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors

Clip编码器:
  放置路径: ComfyUI/models/clip
  下载链接: https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/tree/main

VAE:
  放置路径: ComfyUI/models/vae
  下载链接: https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell/blob/main/ae.sft
